description: App-wide Apex configuration shared by every module (Habitat and Salis). Holds settings that are not scoped to a single domain — for example the GL-posting finance gate and the data-retention windows that govern how long machine-written time-series and alert records are kept.

fields.description: When OFF, Accommodation Ledger rows are operational memos with no GL impact.
fields.label: Enable GL Entry Posting

fields.description: How long machine-written time-series and alert records are kept before the daily log cleanup purges old rows. Blank or 0 falls back to the built-in default for that record. Financial ledgers are never auto-purged.
fields.label: Data Retention

fields.description: Retention for daily occupancy and weekly vehicle-utilisation snapshots (days). Default 365.
fields.label: Snapshot Retention (Days)

fields.description: Retention for submitted Non-Financial Depreciation Snapshots (days). Default 730.
fields.label: Depreciation Snapshot Retention (Days)

fields.description: Retention for resolved Operations Alerts (days). Open and acknowledged alerts are never purged by age. Default 90.
fields.label: Resolved Alert Retention (Days)

name: Apex Settings
